text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/disburse_cycle2.py (P1): it loads all households, selects those where is_eligible(h) is true, builds the set of already-used payment keys from sent_payments(), and calls disburse(household_id, 60, payment_key(household_id, 2)) for each eligible household not yet paid for cycle 2 — the '{household_id}:2' key makes reruns idempotent. It prints a summary of payments made and skipped/already-paid households. Ran it once (P2): 25 eligible households were each paid exactly 60 dollars for cycle 2 (PAY-00023 through PAY-00047), no ineligible household was paid, and a verification rerun paid 0 and reported all 25 as already paid, confirming exactly-once payment.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
